steps.title: Pin the hub
steps.description: Insert four black pins into hub end.
warnings: Prepare the hub battery as shown on page 3 before starting. The hub is counted as one prepared component.

steps.title: Prepare the handle connector
steps.description: Fit gray cross block with four integral pins to first magenta frame.

steps.title: Stack the handle frames
steps.description: Stack second magenta frame onto connector.

steps.title: Attach the handle
steps.description: Join stacked-frame handle to hub pins.

steps.title: Pin the handle end
steps.description: Insert two pins at free end of handle.

steps.title: Align and prepare the motor
steps.description: Prepare the medium motor with two pins and a 3L axle. Align the motor marks as shown in the manual inset. The fixed magenta 5L beam is not the motor crank.

steps.title: Fit the motor link
steps.description: Fit magenta length-5 crank/link and two pins.

steps.title: Prepare the short link
steps.description: Build white short link with tan axle/pin.

steps.title: Add the blue liftarm
steps.description: Fit the medium azure 2L liftarm to the tan axle/pin. Use the liftarm shown in the parts list, not a cable clip.

steps.title: Attach the link to the motor
steps.description: Join white/azure link subassembly to motor assembly.

steps.title: Build the first wheel
steps.description: Fit white wheel hub into tire, first jaw.

steps.title: Axle the first wheel
steps.description: Insert length-3 axle into wheel.

steps.title: Add the first jaw brick
steps.description: Fit magenta 2 x 4 jaw brick with three vertical axle holes to wheel axle.

steps.title: Prepare the first angled link
steps.description: Prepare angled jaw link with length-3 axle.

steps.title: Attach the first jaw
steps.description: Join first wheel/brick jaw to angled link.

steps.title: Add the first jaw pads
steps.description: Add two black round 2 x 2 through-hole tiles to first jaw, leaving axles exposed.

steps.title: Pin the first jaw link
steps.description: Add tan axle/pin to rear of first angled link.

steps.title: Mount the first jaw
steps.description: Attach first jaw to motor/link subassembly.

steps.title: Build the second wheel
steps.description: Fit white wheel hub into tire, second jaw.

steps.title: Axle the second wheel
steps.description: Insert length-3 axle into second wheel.

steps.title: Add the second jaw brick
steps.description: Fit second magenta 2 x 4 jaw brick with three vertical axle holes to wheel axle.

steps.title: Prepare the second angled link
steps.description: Prepare second angled jaw link with length-3 axle.

steps.title: Attach the second jaw
steps.description: Join second wheel/brick jaw to angled link.

steps.title: Add the second jaw pads
steps.description: Add two black round 2 x 2 through-hole tiles to second jaw, leaving axles exposed.

steps.title: Mount the second jaw
steps.description: Attach second jaw to motor/link subassembly.

steps.title: Insert the retaining pin
steps.description: Insert longer black pivot/retaining pin.

steps.title: Couple the jaws
steps.description: Fit gray H-shaped coupling link over rear jaw connections.

steps.title: Join the gripper and handle
steps.description: Turn the completed motor and gripper module, then attach it to the frame handle you built earlier.

steps.title: Connect the motor to port F
steps.description: Plug the motor’s attached cable into port F on the hub. Use the wiring diagram on page 32 to check the connection.
warnings: Cable routing is not shown accurately in 3D. Check that the cable can move freely as the hand opens and closes.

scenarios.title: RoboBuild extension — coupled grip, hold and release
scenarios.description: One real F-powered crank and two solved passive jaws grip the original RoboBuild block, hold it while a scripted human-hand lift moves the actual whole robot, then release continuously and reopen. Lesson Building Tips says left/right buttons; supplied solution SVG instead uses left press/release (startup F clockwise0.2s, press −100% power, release clockwise0.2s). This position-calibrated demonstration does NOT claim to reproduce those uncalibrated power/time endpoints.
